# cJSON

[cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON) by Dave Gamble, release `v1.7.18`: `cJSON.c` and
`cJSON.h`, copied from the release's source archive. MIT licence: see `LICENSE`.

It reads and writes `settings.json` (`port/overlay/settings.c`).

Keep these files as they are upstream, so they can be updated by copying a newer release over them.
